## 1. Summary

Pawtner is a phone app in which a senior looks after a virtual dog, and the dog's wellbeing depends on the senior's medication routine. The usual direction of care is reversed: **the dog depends on her**. A family caretaker manages the routine from a web dashboard and is only alerted when misses repeat.

Behind the dog is an agent that checks the routine, decides when to nudge, refuses unsafe requests, and knows when to say "please ask a professional". Every decision it makes is visible, with the reason.

## 2. Problem

- Older adults on long-term medicines often miss or double doses, and find medicine labels and leaflets hard to understand.
- Reminder apps feel clinical and nagging, and are easy to ignore.
- Family caretakers want reassurance without turning care into surveillance.

| **Caretaker** (secondary) | Web | Know things are OK, edit the routine, be told only when it matters | Weekly summaries, escalation settings, no medicine details in alerts |

| Mood | When | Effects |

---

## 6. Core loop

```
Snap or enter a medicine
  → check it is a registered product (HSA) and confirm the details
  → plain-language explanation, read aloud
  → set the schedule
  → dog nudges at dose time
  → senior taps "Taken" or snaps a photo
  → dog stays happy, streak grows
  → caretaker sees caring moments and a weekly summary
```

---

## 7. The agent

### 7.1 Design principle
**Rules decide; the model only words things.** Every safety and escalation decision is made by deterministic rules with fixed thresholds. A language model is used only to write the dog's wording, write weekly summary prose, read a medicine label into fields the user must confirm, and rephrase trusted medicine text. If the model fails, times out or runs out of quota, the rule's decision stands and a pre-written template is used. The emergency path never calls the model.

### 7.2 What the agent checks

| Signal | Source |
|---|---|
| Dose status: upcoming, due, taken, skipped, missed | Derived from `med_schedules` + `dose_events` (missed is never stored) |
| Consecutive missed doses | Derived from the ledger |
| Blood pressure readings and free-text notes | `health_metrics` |
| Days of supply left | `medications` |
| Nudges already sent per dose | `agent_decisions` |
| Caretaker consent and threshold | `user_caregivers` |

### 7.3 What the agent decides on its own

| Decision | Trigger (demo thresholds, configurable) | Dog mood |
|---|---|---|
| `nudge` (1st) | Dose not taken 60 min after scheduled time | sleepy |
| `nudge` (2nd, last) | Still not taken 60 min after the 1st nudge | sleepy |
| `nudge` + caretaker check-in | Consecutive missed doses ≥ caretaker threshold (minimum 2) **and** senior opted in | sleepy |
| `celebrate` | Dose taken, walk finished, streak milestone | joyful |
| `restock_reminder` | Days of supply ≤ 5 | content |
| `doctor_question` | A note mentions a possible side effect (e.g. "sleepy", "dizzy", "nausea") → added to weekly summary as a question | content |

## 7. The agent

### 7.1 Design principle
**Rules decide; the model only words things.** Every safety and escalation decision is made by deterministic rules with fixed thresholds. {"requestId":"b23ead1083124903b648231992aec202","modelId":"fast-model","modelName":"Fast","isHelperMessage":false,"toolStatus":{"call_KeYIDVyHgt8vKnNTznZyPVVs":{"ready":true,"status":"executed","args":{"command":"cd Pawtner-repo && cat docs/TIER2_AGENT_HANDOFF.md 2>/dev/null | head -200","requires_approval":true,"explanation":"Read tier 2 agent handoff"},"result":{"success":true,"status":"success","result":{"type":"execute_command_result","stdout":"# Tier 2 Agent Handoff

Updated 2026-10-14. This is a working brief for the next agent continuing Tier 2 in Pawtner. Treat the root [`PRD.md`](../PRD.md), especially sections 7–10, as the product authority. [`docs/KANBAN.md`](KANBAN.md) and [`docs/HANDOFF.md`](HANDOFF.md) are status/context, but may lag the code. Confirm the actual working tree before editing.

## Mission

Continue the medicine and care-management work in Tier 2 while preserving the already-working Tier 1 demo. The highest-value path is a trustworthy medication setup loop:

1. Enter or photograph a medicine label.
2. Extract candidate fields and find possible matches in the official Singapore HSA register.
3. Let the user inspect and confirm every field; never save OCR output automatically.
4. Offer trusted, attributed medicine information and read-aloud, with safe fallback behavior.
5. Save the confirmed medicine and schedule so they appear in the senior app.

Tier 2 is broader than medication scanning. Its PRD items are T2-01 through T2-13; after the medication path, use the remaining time on the smallest complete vertical slices (photo storage, caretaker editing, GPS/walk rewards, treats and derived milestones). Preserve demo reliability over breadth.

## Start here: protect the existing checkout

- This repository has pre-existing and in-progress user changes. Inspect `git status --short` and `git diff` before modifying anything. Do not reset, clean, switch branches, or discard files.
- Work in the current checkout unless the user explicitly asks for an isolated worktree. Several agents/tools may share the same files.
- Do not commit, push, merge, or deploy without the user's explicit authorization in the session. The project handoff says only the user merges PRs.
- Do not print, paste, or log `.env` values. Never expose connection strings or API keys.
- The configured database may be shared. Do not run a destructive import, migration, seed, or object-storage upload against it without checking the exact target and whether the operation is expected. The HSA importer described below replaces the product table in one transaction; it has not been run as part of this handoff preparation.

## Current project shape

- `api/`: Node/TypeScript HTTP handlers and PostgreSQL repository (`pg`).
- `shared/`: provisional app contracts, deterministic decision rules, selectors and fixtures. Rules decide; a model may only word/rephrase trusted text.
- `migrations/`: SQL schema and fictional seed. `001_init.sql` creates the core schema; later numbered migrations are applied by `scripts/migrate.ts`.
- `mobile/`: Vite + React + TypeScript m
... (content truncated) ...
ersistence and `/care` editing so the confirmed flow actually affects Home.
5. Add MedlinePlus explanation/rephrase checks, prescribed-for field, read-aloud and source links.
6. Add label/proof image storage only once the server-side storage provider/deployment settings are known.
7. Pick one of foreground GPS, data-derived souvenirs/milestones, or caretaker treats based on remaining time and demo impact; preserve simulated walk fallback.
8. Update PRD/Kanban/Handoff/README to match reality and list incomplete/blocked items honestly.

If scope is constrained, prioritize a user-visible, safe manual medication setup and persisted schedule over a flashy scanner or live GPS. Do not claim unimplemented OCR, upload, OCR confidence, medication knowledge, or production security.

## Verification and completion checklist

For each slice, add/update focused unit or integration coverage as appropriate. The repository has existing scripts; check package scripts before assuming names. Typical checks include:

- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run test:unit`
- `npm run test:integration` with an explicitly configured isolated test database (tests skip without `DATABASE_URL`)
- `npm --prefix mobile run build` (inspect mobile scripts first)
- Local UI/API walkthrough in browser for success, empty, manual, and error states.

Do not run tests or mutate remote/shared data without considering repository instructions and the user’s current authorization. For importer verification, prefer a mocked fetch and isolated schema; for migrations use temporary schema/database. Never run importer against the user's configured shared database simply as a smoke test.

Before handing back:

- Summarize which T2 IDs are done, partial, or blocked in `docs/KANBAN.md`.
- Record material decisions in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.
- Update `docs/HANDOFF.md` and README setup/environment instructions.

Reword the pill photo check on \`mobile/src/screens/ProofScreen.tsx\` so it stays on the right side of **PRD §7.4 — Identifying a pill from a photo: refuses. ## Changes

### \`mobile/src/locales/en.json\`
New \`proof.check.*\` block using \`{{name}}\` interpolation. Approved wording verbatim:

| Key | English |
|---|---|
| \`proof.check.button\` | Compare with my first photo |
| \`proof.check.checking\` | {{name}} is looking… |
| \`proof.check.described.title\` | First photo saved |
| \`proof.check.described.note\` | Next time, {{name}} will compare your photo with this one. |
| \`proof.check.verified.match\` | Looks like your usual pill |
| \`proof.check.verified.diff\` | This looks different from your usual pill. Please check the package before you take it. |
| \`proof.check.verified.savedLabel\` | Your first photo: |
| \`proof.check.verified.newLabel\` | This photo: |
| \`proof.check.error\` | {{name}} can't compare photos right now. Your proof photo still counts. |
| \`proof.check.disclosure\` | {{name}} only compares this photo with your earlier one. It can't tell you what a pill is. Always check the package and ask your pharmacist. |

### \`mobile/src/screens/ProofScreen.tsx\`
- **Move every English string** on the screen to \`t(\`proof.check.*\`)\`.
- **Drop the similarity percentage** (\`Math.round(check.result.similarity * 100)%\`) from the verified card — never identify a pill, even by %.
- **Error state:** never render the raw error message. Show \`proof.check.error\` and \`console.warn(\"Proof screen pill check failed:\", error)\` for diagnosis. The \`CheckState\` error variant no longer carries a message field.
- **Tone:** the verified.match / verified.diff copy is intentionally non-identifying ("looks like your usual pill" / "this looks different from your usual pill… please check the package"). The T2-02 disclosure is kept and externalised under \`proof.check.disclosure\`.
- **Give {{name}} a heart** still renders and still calls \`onVerified\` regardless of check state.
- **Inline styles → classes:** all 10 inline \`style={{…}}\` usages in the pill check block moved to existing-stylesheet classes; no raw hex in the component; existing colour tokens reused (sage, text, action-stop).

### \`mobile/src/index.css\`
New rules (\`proof-photo-preview\`, \`proof-photo-input\`, \`proof-check-block\`, \`proof-check-card\`, \`proof-check-card-title\`, \`proof-check-card-line\`, \`proof-check-card-note\`, \`proof-checking-status\`, \`proof-check-error\`, \`proof-check-disclosure\`) added alongside the existing Fields / proof section. Names distinguish them from the pre-existing \`.proof-check\` scanner badge to avoid a collision.
